operation.description:
Create new or update existing custom property values for a repository.
Using a value of `null` for a custom property will remove or 'unset' the property value from the repository.

Repository admins and other users with the repository-level "edit custom property values" fine-grained permission can use this endpoint.

properties.description: A list of custom property names and associated values to apply to the repositories.

204.description: No Content when custom property values are successfully created or updated

operation.summary: Create or update custom property values for a repository

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

#/components/responses/validation_failed.description: Validation failed, or the endpoint has been spammed.

#/components/schemas/custom-property-val.description: Custom property name and associated value

value.description: The value assigned to the property

#/components/schemas/custom-property-val.title: Custom Property Value
